cta.title: All nine. One store. Zero robots.

lede: Nine tees. Twenty-five bucks each. Real designs, drawn from real lines a real human actually says — no focus groups, no AI slop wall, no fake countdown timers. The store runs on Fourthwall: you order, they print it and ship it, a human keeps the difference. Here's the whole first drop:
